_readme: Preview scene fixups. Each scope names a folded model-path substring and
the geometry names to hide or show inside it. Patterns take a leading
and/or trailing * and nothing else. A show beats a hide, and rescues a
piece the built-in helper-token rule catches by mistake; it deliberately
cannot rescue an embedded body or an out-of-slot hands/feet mesh.
Drop your own file in this folder. Files are read in sorted order and
merged, and one that will not parse costs only its own scopes.

_why: The Lili Collection ships SMP collision proxies as ordinary geometry,
so the previewer draws them: a ring around the neck on the choker card
and three hulls inside the dresses. Censused whole with
tools/nif_name_census.py over the mod's meshes/ folders, which found
ColChokerNeck on 6 NIFs and ColSkirtFeet, ColSkirtLegs and
The pattern is _col rather than col because this mod's real garment
pieces are Corset, Cardigan and every name containing LiliCollection.
A bare col substring would hide the entire mod. _col matches the four
proxies and none of the pieces, which is checkable because this mod
was censused whole; it is not checkable across the whole load order,
which is exactly why the rule is scoped to this path.
